summary.plain: The upgraded COMPASS spectrometer in Hall EHN2, with new liquid-hydrogen and liquid-helium targets and additional detectors for each measurement.
summary.technical: Upgraded COMPASS two-stage magnetic spectrometer in EHN2, equipped with liquid hydrogen/helium targets, with measurement-specific instrumentation (and, for some proposals, a dedicated target spectrometer with tracking and electromagnetic calorimetry).
